failure_classes.title: extract_hidden_states e2e connector block-size mismatch
failure_classes.signature: ValueError: Hidden-states block-size mismatch: derived 256 but buffer block size is 3 (e2e test_extract_hidden_states x3; upstream example_hidden_states_connector.register_kv_caches check)
failure_classes.layer: vllm-ascend adaptation (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py KV cache reshape) x upstream connector geometry check
failure_classes.root_cause: After upstream #51718 removed CacheOnlyAttentionBackend.get_kv_cache_shape, the adapter's _reshape_kv_cache_v2 reshapes the KV cache along the num_states dimension, but on the 0.28.0 release lane that geometry field is named/semantics-different (storage_block_size vs num_states), so the reshaped shape fails the connector's block-size check.

fix.how: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py — _reshape_kv_cache_v2 gates the state dimension by lane: num_states = kv_cache_spec.storage_block_size if vllm_version_is('0.28.0') else kv_cache_spec.num_states (the matching tuple dimension in kv_cache_shape switches with it).

failure_classes.lesson: After an upstream backend method (get_kv_cache_shape) is deleted, every adapter path that reshapes by its return values must be re-derived; put the lane gate at the geometry field's source, not at each call site.

failure_classes.title: spec-decode acceptance collapse (dflash/dspark/glm5.2; no crash, pure accuracy)
failure_classes.signature: AssertionError: acceptance_per_pos [...] does not match golden [...] | Acceptance length regression detected for Eco-Tech/GLM-5.2-w4a8! Expected: 3.500 Actual: 1.197 Relative error: 65.79% (typical: dflash pos0 0.39 vs golden 0.51; dspark ~halved; dflash2 [0.0099,...] vs [0.855,...]; glm5.2 1.197 vs 3.500. NO vllm_ascend frames in the traceback.)
failure_classes.layer: vllm-ascend adaptation (draft attention metadata construction shim's default values)
failure_classes.root_cause: Upstream vllm 62f3bf58 -> 39545e47 renamed the speculator metadata build method and DELETED the DFlash/DSpark overrides. The adapter added a shim to keep the old call sites working (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/draft_attn_metadata.py), and its _build_draft_attn_metadata(..., num_query_per_req: int = 1) default was silently adopted by the call sites — they only passed step=self.num_query_per_req, not num_query_per_req. The step=K vs num_query_per_req=1 mismatch makes the draft attn metadata claim 1 query token per request (actually dflash 8 / dspark 7); the Ascend-side actual_seq_lengths_q patch then masks the FIA tiling crash, leaving silently misaligned attention -> acceptance collapse. eagle/MTP stay green because their 1-token-per-step semantics happen to be correct.

fix.how: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py and dspark/speculator.py — both build_draft_attn_metadatas call sites change from self._build_draft_attn_metadata(num_reqs=..., num_reqs_padded=..., num_tokens_padded=..., seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=..., step=self.num_query_per_req, causal=...) to self._build_uniform_attn_metadata(batch_desc=BatchExecutionDescriptor(cg_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL, num_tokens=num_tokens_padded, num_reqs=num_reqs_padded), num_reqs=self.input_batch.num_reqs, num_query_per_req=self.num_query_per_req, seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=..., step=self.num_query_per_req, causal=...). I.e.: pass num_query_per_req=self.num_query_per_req EXPLICITLY (stop eating the shim default) and go through the uniform build path.
fix.note: Methodology: for 'metric assertion + no vllm_ascend frames' failures the log cannot locate the root cause; the evidence lives in the upstream DELETED override (a deleted override's implicit contract = the parameters it injected). Verify against the metric itself, not against 'does not crash'. #16575 is open (pending CI/merge). #16554: own leg 12 cases 89.4%, release leg 4 cases 96.5% — both legs collapsed together because the mixin inside the PR diff applies to both legs. cross_cutting.detail: main2main PRs are a sequentially REGENERATED patch series against main; fixes present on an earlier PR's tree vanish in later regenerations. Four proven cases: (a) ascend-input-batch-missing-max-seq-len-np — 16159's gated kwarg dropped by 16296's regeneration -> 27 case failures; (b) kv-coordinator-allow-partial-hash-hits — fix present at 16424 head, gone at 16439 head -> 16439 fails; (c) kimi-k3-dspark-embed-tokens-none — fix present at 16466 head, gone at 16483/16554/16575 heads -> still unfixed; (d) model-config-mrope-num-dims-missing — the lane guard was regenerated into an unconditional read -> release lane always fails.
cross_cutting.implication: Verifying 'fixed' MUST be done against the current head tree, never by citing a historical PR's diff. When monitoring sees a same-class failure regress, suspect regeneration loss first, new breakage second.

cross_cutting.detail: 'Release lane lacks main's new field' (extract-hidden-states-connector-block-size, mrv2-unsupported-extract-hidden-states, model-config-mrope-num-dims-missing: TypeError/AttributeError) vs 'main changed a structure that release did not' (mamba-copy-funcs-tuple-index, ascend-input-batch-missing-max-seq-len-np: structure/type drift).
cross_cutting.implication: The fix shape is uniformly a vllm_version_is(...) gate, placed at the GEOMETRY/SIGNATURE SOURCE (e.g. init_block_table_layout_tensors(), layer_state_copy_funcs()), not scattered across call sites.

cross_cutting.finding: Signature triage rules (directly usable by monitoring / fix rounds)
rules: TypeError ... unexpected keyword argument / missing 1 required positional argument -> API drift; look up the upstream PR that changed the signature (logs/comments usually name it, e.g. #54282/#54505).
AttributeError: no attribute -> rename/module move; check upstream git log first, then fix the import.

Metric assertion + traceback with no vllm_ascend frames (spec-decode-acceptance-collapse-shim-default) -> silent contract drift; logs cannot locate it; evidence is in the upstream DELETED override (a deleted override's implicit contract = the parameters it injected). Verify against the metric itself, not 'does not crash'.
aclnn 561002 / EZ1008 (pcp-spec-decode-npu-op-crash-family) -> NPU operator/tiling layer; adaptation-layer changes are all ineffective; capture operator inputs and compare against CANN docs.
